rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something that has been planned or put on the schedule.

example.english: The meeting was scheduled long ago.
example.jyutping: go3 wui6 jat1 zou2 on1 paai4 zo2 laa3

rows.note: Use this when a surgery, appointment, test, or other event has been given a scheduled date or time.

example.english: I am scheduled for surgery next month.
example.traditional: 我下個月排咗期做手術。
example.jyutping: ngo5 haa5 go3 jyut6 paai4 zo2 kei4 zou6 sau2 seot6
